```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# =================================
# GOOGLE SHEET
# =================================

sheet_url <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vSS9xAr-Vm_XPEKsvPz9A1RWtIEW3R50nqcilODNggostrkW7ms5O84Dgrp9vheOer-K8Pu5PDtsgg2/pub?output=csv"

lectures <- read_csv(
  sheet_url,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# =================================
# DETECT CURRENT QMD FILE
# =================================

current_file <- knitr::current_input(
  dir = FALSE
)

current_filename <- basename(
  current_file
)

# =================================
# EXTRACT LECTURE NUMBER
# =================================

lecture_match <- str_match(
  current_filename,
  "lecture-([0-9]+)"
)

if (is.na(lecture_match[1, 2])) {

  stop(
    paste0(
      "Could not detect lecture number from file: ",
      current_filename
    )
  )

}

lecture_no <- as.integer(
  lecture_match[1, 2]
)

# =================================
# FIND MATCHING LECTURE
# =================================

lecture <- lectures %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(`CLASS NO.`),
    as.integer(`CLASS NO.`) == lecture_no
  ) %>%
  slice(1)

# =================================
# DEFAULT VALUES
# =================================

lecture_date <- ""
chapter <- ""
content <- ""

# =================================
# GET DATA
# =================================

if (nrow(lecture) > 0) {

  lecture_date <- lecture$`TUTORING DATE`[1]

  chapter <- lecture$`CHAPTERS & PAPER`[1]

  content <- lecture$CONTENT[1]

}

# =================================
# HANDLE NA
# =================================

if (is.na(lecture_date)) {
  lecture_date <- ""
}

if (is.na(chapter)) {
  chapter <- ""
}

if (is.na(content)) {
  content <- ""
}

# =================================
# CONVERT TO CHARACTER
# =================================

lecture_date <- str_trim(
  as.character(lecture_date)
)

chapter <- str_trim(
  as.character(chapter)
)

content <- str_trim(
  as.character(content)
)

# =================================
# FORMAT CHAPTER LINE BREAKS
# =================================

chapter <- str_replace_all(
  chapter,
  "\\r?\\n",
  "<br>"
)

# =================================
# WEEKLY EXAM DETECTION
# =================================

weekly_exam_match <- str_match(
  content,
  "^\\s*([0-9]+)\\s*-\\s*Weekly exam of previous lectures and problem solving\\s*$"
)

is_weekly_exam <- !is.na(
  weekly_exam_match[1, 1]
)

# =================================
# WEEKLY EXAM NUMBER
# =================================

weekly_exam_no <- ""

if (is_weekly_exam) {

  weekly_exam_no <- sprintf(
    "%02d",
    as.integer(
      weekly_exam_match[1, 2]
    )
  )

}

# =================================
# WEEKLY EXAM DESCRIPTION
# =================================

weekly_exam_description <- ""

if (is_weekly_exam) {

  weekly_exam_description <-
    "Weekly exam of previous lectures and problem solving"

}

# =================================
# WEEKLY EXAM BADGE
# =================================

weekly_badge <- ""

if (is_weekly_exam) {

  weekly_badge <- paste0(
    '<span class="weekly-exam-corner-badge">',
    'WEEKLY ',
    weekly_exam_no,
    '</span>'
  )

}

```

[b. $7$]{.mcq-badge}
[c. $9$]{.mcq-badge}
[d. $11$]{.mcq-badge}

:::

::: q-card

[a. $40$]{.mcq-badge}
[b. $140$]{.mcq-badge}
[c. $60$]{.mcq-badge}
[d. $120$]{.mcq-badge}
:::

::: q-card
[ Question-03 ]{.q-number}

What is the period of $\sin^22(2\theta+3)$?

[a. $\frac{\pi}{2}$]{.mcq-badge} 
[b. $\frac{\pi}{3}$]{.mcq-badge} 
[c. $\frac{\pi}{4}$]{.mcq-badge} 
[d. $\frac{\pi}{6}$]{.mcq-badge}
:::

::: q-card
[ Question-04 ]{.q-number}

[b. $150^\circ$]{.mcq-badge} 
[c. $157.5^\circ$]{.mcq-badge} 
[d. $165^\circ$]{.mcq-badge}

::: q-card
[ Question-05 ]{.q-number}

If $\tan\theta = \frac{5}{12},\ cos\theta$ is negative then what is the value of $\sin\theta$?

[a. $-\frac{5}{13}$]{.mcq-badge} 
[b. $\frac{5}{13}$]{.mcq-badge} 
[c. $-\frac{12}{13}$]{.mcq-badge} 
[d. $\frac{12}{13}$]{.mcq-badge}
:::

::: q-card
[ Question-06 ]{.q-number}

What is the value of 1 radian?

[b. $\frac{2}{\pi}$ right angle]{.mcq-badge} 
[c. $2$ right angle]{.mcq-badge} 
[d. $\pi$ right angle]{.mcq-badge}
:::

::: q-card
[ Question-07 ]{.q-number}

What is the range of $f(x) = \sqrt{1-\sin^2\theta}$?

[a. $\{-1,1\}$]{.mcq-badge} 
[b. $[-1,1]$]{.mcq-badge} 
[c. $(-1,1)$]{.mcq-badge} 
[d. $(-\infty, \infty)$]{.mcq-badge}
:::

::: q-card
[ Question-08 ]{.q-number}

A car wheel rotates 90 times per second. Through how many degrees does the wheel rotate in 1 second?

[a. $180^\circ$]{.mcq-badge}
[b. $270^\circ$]{.mcq-badge}
[c. $360^\circ$]{.mcq-badge}
[d. $540^\circ$]{.mcq-badge}
:::

::: q-card
[ Question-09 ]{.q-number}

What is the ratio of the circumference of a circle to its diameter?

[a. $\frac{\pi r}{2}$]{.mcq-badge}
[b. $2\pi$]{.mcq-badge}
[c. $\pi$]{.mcq-badge}
[d. $2$]{.mcq-badge}
:::

::: q-card
[ Question-10 ]{.q-number}

What is the domain of function $\cot\theta$?

[a. $\mathbb{R}$]{.mcq-badge}
[b. $\mathbb{R} - \{(2n+1)\frac{\pi}{2}:n\in\mathbb{Z}\}$]{.mcq-badge}
[c. $\mathbb{R} - \{n\pi:n \in\mathbb{N}\}$]{.mcq-badge}
[d. None]{.mcq-badge}

## CQ Part (20 Marks)

::: q-card
[ Question-01 ]{.q-number}

**Read the following statement:**
$$
f(\theta) = \frac{1+\cos^2\theta}{\cos\theta}
$$
$$
g(x) = \cos x
$$

(a) ***(2 marks)*** If $\sin^2\alpha - \cos\alpha = 0$, then prove that, $\tan^4\alpha - \sec^2\alpha = 0$.
(b) ***(4 marks)*** If $f(\theta) = \frac{5}{2}$, then prove that, $\cos^n\theta + \sec^n\theta = 2^n + 2^{-n}$.
(c) ***(4 marks)*** Sketch the graph of $g(x)$ over the interval $-\frac{\pi}{2} \le x \le \frac{\pi}{2}$.
:::

::: q-card
[ Question-02 ]{.q-number}

**Read the following statement:**
$$
f(\theta) = \theta + \tan\alpha
$$
$$
g(z) = \sqrt{(1-\cos z)(1+\cos z)}
$$

(a) ***(2 marks)*** If $\sin A = 0.8$, then find the value of $\tan A$ over the interval $[\frac{\pi}{2}, \pi]$.
(b) ***(4 marks)*** If $f(\sec\alpha) = x$, then prove that, $g(\alpha) = \frac{x^2-1}{x^2+1}$.
(c) ***(4 marks)*** Show that, $\{\sum g(A)\}^2 = \sum\{g(A)\}^2$ when,  $\frac{1}{g(A)} + \frac{1}{g(B)} + \frac{1}{g(C)} = 0$.
:::
